cards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished 2D pixel-art companion trading card for Roblox game Scaffolding Tycoon, portrait 2:3, straight-on flat asset filling canvas, no surrounding scene. References are style guides only: Sand Wizard for chunky pixel character and card arrangement, cash for crisp coarse square pixel clusters and dark outlines. Original ELECTRIC companion: small charming block-built electrical golem with square head, luminous yellow eyes, dark teal iron body, yellow lightning core, short chunky limbs, little lightning arcs, stone workshop backdrop. Strict intentional low-resolution pixel-art look, logical 160x240 pixel grid enlarged by integer nearest-neighbor, no smooth gradients, no blur, no vector curves, no tiny painterly detail. Limited palette, coarse Minecraft-like mottled stone/metal texture, 1 logical pixel dark outlines. Reusable layout: dark stepped rectangular border with gray stone COMMON trim, top title 'ELECTRIC', directly below smaller 'COMMON', central character panel covering middle 60%, bottom dark panel with exactly three horizontal stat bars. Labels verbatim 'DAMAGE', 'STAMINA', 'HEALTH'; at right of each row 'MAX 20'. Bars are empty dark segmented tracks, caps only, no invented current values. Damage accent orange, stamina cyan, health red. Block pixel typography clear and readable. Same visual pixel scale throughout. No logo, signature, watermark, extra text, photorealism or 3D rendering.
